admission CI: t-interval on the TWO paired warm log-ratio differences (blocks 2-3; 1 dof), reported with its very limited small-sample precision; the 5-pair CI shape is the Q00/Q10 protocol, not the screen's

statistics.per_block_ratio: r_i = b0_wall_i / cand_wall_i, computed for EVERY block (F1R discipline: unit = the pair); r_1 is recorded for the cold record and cold_regression; blocks 2-3 feed every governing statistic

statistics.cold_regression: cand_wall_block1 / b0_wall_block1 (>1 = candidate slower on first process) - includes block 1 BY DEFINITION; the ONLY admission-relevant block-1 quantity, governed by G4
statistics.proxy_prohibition: FORBIDDEN: comparing the blocks 1-3 proxy (or the 3-pair CI) against the G3 preregistered minimum delta, evaluating either under the G3 noise guard, or citing either as admission evidence in any disposition.
